answer: Correlated-answer slashing: every agent locks a 200-token bond as its anchor, then answers a task the epoch beacon picks after bonds lock, so nothing can be pre-planned. Random juries compare answers; when several identities show wording and reasoning that cluster far above chance, the whole cluster is slashed together. Clones share one model and prompt, so they correlate; staying apart needs fresh reasoning per fake, which cannot be replayed. A 100-clone farm risks 20,000 tokens each epoch to earn what one honest agent earns, so no ivory tower of fakes pays.
